subset.scope: Every prerequisite bit is available; an empty chunk is allowed.

coverage.scope: Nonempty source-facet coverage; absent facets cannot be accepted.

learning_ready.scope: Projects require teaching; exercises additionally require prior project practice, per 64-bit chunk.

ordered_edge.scope: Every prerequisite precedes its consumer in the finite learning graph.

next_stage.scope: Only the current nonterminal sequential stage is eligible.

evidence_complete.scope: Exact baseline/holdout facet sets, all three causal domains, recovery and provenance are indivisible.

report_complete.scope: A proof/report succeeds only with the exact nonempty checklist and no failures.

receipt_current.scope: An observation belongs to exactly one nonzero attempt and exercise.
